instruction: Buy me a board game on amazon under $20 (excluding tax), over 3.9 rating, and over 4 reviews, and have it delivered to home address.
notes: Single-app purchase task. The qualifying product is a runtime-selected object: search_products with query/product_type/max_price/min_product_rating filters yields candidates, and show_product verifies the strict criteria (price < 20 before tax, rating > 3.9, more than 4 reviews) before it may be added to the cart. add_product_to_cart uses quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity 1 (cart changes are not penalized). The home address id is obtained by matching supervisor.show_addresses (name 'Home') against amazon.show_addresses; no address or payment card may be updated/deleted, so only read lookups are modeled. Payment card is any existing amazon card. complete_task takes no API answer; its extra parameters are the task records (product, address) needed to state the goal condition in its precondition.

plan: (amazon-add-address home-address-name home-address-street home-address-city home-address-state home-address-country home-address-zip amazon-token home-address)
